notes.title: Version 1.1.3
notes.content:
List of changes:

[list]
[*] Added ability to restart the zone if you stuck
[*] "Head Hunter" missions could be started more than once if needed
[*] Creatures try to exactly repeat the leader's way
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831538/1ddc32c0831783b8576738456d75467dd96e103a.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] now it is possible to break towers without 'Ram'
[*] slimes with 'Fast Reflexes' do not break towers and do not get damaged when touching blue/orange blocks
[*] towers that are partially destroyed will be repaired on the next turn
[*] behemoths speed is increased and health is decreased
[*] added music/sound volume to settings
[*] added German and Ukrainian languages
[*] TFLM4 tower rebalanced
[*] some bugs fixed
[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831538/0261425b25bbec1f7e4d936f4466e20eb5e8b8a6.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Update 1.0.1
[list]
[*] Scorched earth now decreases speed on 20%, not 40%
[*] Towers do not appear out of the "Exile" mission map
[*] Protoplasm structuring now is less predictable
[*] "Exile" mission now is a bit more dangerous... for both sides
[*] Small performance tweaks
[*] If you skip tutorial you will get 'Ram' ability anyway
[/list]
